cases.name: Laura Kate Smither
cases.about: She was a gifted and talented student, scuba diver, and a Girl Scout. Laura was an intelligent, beautiful, gentle, loving child with a passion for ballet and a great joy for life.
cases.narrative: On 4/20/1997, her body was found in a retention pond in Pasadena.
